Ana M: Morning! I'm Ana, starting today :wave:. Quick security onboarding q's: 1) I'm on a personal Linux laptop (Fedora). Do we require MDM for Linux? What's the recommended disk encryption setup (LUKS?) and any config script? 2) I need a YubiKey — can it be mailed? 3) I'm scheduled for the phishing sim next Tuesday but I have a dentist appt; is there an opt/reschedule process? 4) Who do I ping for HSM/dev-key access for local dev? Thanks!

Rajat (People Ops): welcome Ana! :tada: tagging @Kelsey (InfoSec) & Sam from IT. For yubikey we can mail, yes. Also we can issue a loaner laptop if you prefer corporate device.

Kelsey (InfoSec): hi Ana — short answers: 1) For Linux we don't force MDM currently; we require disk encryption and basic hardening. Recommended: LUKS full-disk + `ufw` firewall + automatic updates. We have a short setup script in the wiki you can run. Example checks: ```lsblk -o NAME,TYPE,SIZE,FSTYPE,MOUNTPOINT
sudo cryptsetup status /dev/sda2``` 2) YubiKey: we'll mail via IT after you fill the delivery form (link in DM). 3) Phishsim — you can request an exemption/reschedule in the training portal up to 48h before the test; if it's unavoidable, reply here with your time and we can flag you. 4) HSM/dev access: requires completion of 'HSM Onboarding' training and an approval request form; please submit the form and cc me.

Sam (IT): @Ana M — if you'd like the loaner, tell me your shipping address and I'll put it on a quick ship. YubiKey mail costs are covered. Also if you run into driver/kernel issues for the yubikey on Fedora, ping me and I can provide config.

Ana M: thanks — I'll run the script tonight. Can you paste the wiki link? Also I can do the HSM training tomorrow. Shipping address DM'd :thumbsup:

Onboarding Bot: Assigned: "Security Fundamentals" training -> due in 7 days. Phishing simulation scheduled: 2026-02-24 15:00 UTC. You can request reschedule via https://training.internal/redwood (form).

Kelsey (InfoSec): added the wiki link: https://intra.redwood/sec/linux-hardening (internal) Also noted phish sim — Rajat, can we flag Ana to exclude if she confirms dentist? (It's within 48h)

Rajat (People Ops): noted, will flag if Ana confirms time. Also Ana, you'll get an email with the yubikey/delivery form shortly.

Ana M: confirmed — dentist is 2026-02-24 15:30-16:30 UTC (overlaps). If you can exclude me that'd be 🙏

Rajat (People Ops): marked for exclusion; will update the training portal.

Kelsey (InfoSec): once you finish the script, post `security-check:ok` here and we'll do quick approval for HSM training signoff.

Ana M: security-check:ok — ran through steps, LUKS passphrase set and script exited clean. Thanks everyone :smile:
